Independent static review of the source, canonical actions and relevant richer session outputs found no canned responses or hidden-test access. These local checks are focused; the final hidden suite passes all 223 unique cases without skips or errors. The original tool count is unavailable under the conservative parser; any subsequent exact recovery is recorded separately in a linked tool-count audit. No scoring change or regrade was needed.
